analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color (13 Nov 2026)
key_insights: Indices were lower at midday as the AI/semiconductor trade stayed under pressure. 60% of the SPX was green and SPX ex-AI (SPXXAI Index) was +40bps.
Rates were higher after this morning's PPI, which led GS economics to reduce its core PCE estimate. Crude traded above $95.

Semis fell across the board: NVDA -3.3%, AVGO -5.2%, AMD -10.6%, GSTMTSEM Index -3.8%. NVDA has erased about $500bn of market cap week to date. Yesterday's rotation within semis, where beneficiaries outperformed, did not repeat.
Hyperscalers benefited from the rotation out of semis today.
News flow was light. MSFT's outage yesterday was the focus and the stock was trading in the green. The GS TMT Cyber Security basket (GSTMTCYB Index) was -1.5%.
Next week's focus: Warsh speaks Monday and NVDA reports earnings Tuesday.
Exchange volumes were muted at -2% vs the 5-day moving average. ETFs were elevated at 32% of the tape. SPX top-of-book liquidity was only $4.8mm.

GS desk activity was 5 out of 10. Franchise flows skewed 14.5% better for sale. Both HFs and long-only clients were significantly skewed better for sale, with supply in information tech, macro products and consumer services.
Chart of the Day: Hyperscalers look attractive within Technology. Their P/E has fallen sharply and has nearly closed the gap with the other 495 companies in the US.

market_movers.rationale: NVDA fell 3.3% on the day and has lost about $500bn of market cap this week. Earnings are due Tuesday.
AVGO fell 5.2% as semis sold off broadly.
AMD fell 10.6%, the largest decline among the semis named.
MSFT was trading in the green after yesterday's outage, and hyperscalers benefited from the rotation out of semis.

sector_views.rationale: Hyperscaler P/E has fallen sharply and has nearly closed the gap with the other 495 companies in the US. The desk calls them particularly attractive.
The whole group was under pressure, with GSTMTSEM Index -3.8%. This is a description of the day's tape, not a formal rating.

earnings_insights: NVDA earnings are due Tuesday, 17 Nov 2026 (the document says 'Tuesday' next week). The note gives no estimates.
